Bấm để máy tự động đọc lần lượt từng từ và hiển thị theo dõi (phù hợp học trên điện thoại)
1. autonomous (adj)
/ɔːˈtɒnəməs/
tự hành, tự động ra quyết định độc lập không cần con người điều khiển (n: autonomy)
Collocation: autonomous vehicles, autonomous robots, autonomous systems
"Autonomous delivery drones and self-driving lorries are transforming global logistics."
2. displace (v)
/dɪsˈpleɪs/
thay thế chỗ, đẩy người lao động ra khỏi vị trí công việc cũ (n: workforce displacement)
Collocation: displace routine workers, workforce displacement, be displaced by AI
"While automation may displace clerical workers, it simultaneously creates new high-tech jobs."
3. augment (v)
/ɔːɡˈment/
bổ trợ, nâng cao, tăng cường năng lực của con người (thay vì thay thế hoàn toàn — n: augmentation)
Collocation: augment human intelligence, augment productivity, augment doctors' skills
"Rather than replacing surgeons, diagnostic AI is designed to augment their precision and speed."
4. obsolete (adj)
/ˈɒbsəliːt/
lỗi thời, không còn được sử dụng nữa vì đã có công nghệ mới thay thế
Collocation: render skills obsolete, become obsolete, obsolete machinery
"Rapid technological innovation can render traditional manufacturing skills obsolete within a decade."
5. reskill (v)
/ˌriːˈskɪl/
đào tạo lại kỹ năng mới cho người lao động để thích ứng với thời đại AI (n: reskilling)
Collocation: reskill the workforce, vocational reskilling programmes
"Governments and corporations must collaborate to reskill workers whose jobs are automated."
6. productivity (n)
/ˌprɒdʌkˈtɪvəti/
năng suất lao động, hiệu suất làm việc (adj: productive)
Collocation: boost economic productivity, workplace productivity, productivity gains
"Integrating generative AI into office workflows has boosted employee productivity by 35%."
7. surveillance (n)
/sɜːˈveɪləns/
sự giám sát bằng công nghệ nhận diện khuôn mặt/AI (ôn tập nâng cao)
Collocation: AI facial surveillance, mass digital surveillance
"Civil liberties groups warn against the unchecked expansion of biometric surveillance in public spaces."
8. correlation (n)
/ˌkɒrəˈleɪʃn/
mối tương quan, sự liên hệ mật thiết giữa hai biểu đồ/biến số (từ khóa vàng cho Task 1 Mixed Charts)
Collocation: a positive correlation between A and B, close correlation, direct correlation
"A comparison of the two charts reveals a strong positive correlation between AI investment and productivity."
9. converse (adj/n)
/ˈkɒnvɜːs/
ngược lại, chiều ngược lại (adv: conversely — ngược lại, dùng để đối chiếu 2 xu hướng trái chiều)
Collocation: Conversely, the bar chart shows... / the converse pattern
"Software engineering jobs surged by 60%; conversely, routine data-entry roles plummeted."
10. simultaneous (adj)
/ˌsɪmlˈteɪniəs/
đồng thời, diễn ra cùng một lúc (adv: simultaneously)
Collocation: simultaneous growth, occur simultaneously
"The line graph and table illustrate the simultaneous rise in AI adoption and retraining expenditure."
11. coexist (v)
/ˌkəʊɪɡˈzɪst/
cùng tồn tại, chung sống hài hòa (n: coexistence)
Collocation: coexist harmoniously with AI, human-machine coexistence
"Education must prepare the next generation to coexist and collaborate productively with intelligent machines."
12. accountable (adj)
/əˈkaʊntəbl/
chịu trách nhiệm giải trình trước pháp luật và xã hội (n: accountability)
Collocation: hold tech companies accountable, legally accountable for
"When an autonomous car causes an accident, regulators must determine who is legally accountable."
13. governance (n)
/ˈɡʌvənəns/
sự quản trị, cơ chế quản lý và điều tiết (AI governance / global governance)
Collocation: global AI governance, ethical governance framework
"International summits are establishing a global governance framework to ensure AI safety."
14. synthesis (n)
/ˈsɪnθəsɪs/
sự tổng hợp, sự kết hợp hài hòa giữa nhiều yếu tố (v: synthesize)
Collocation: a synthesis of human empathy and machine speed
"The future of healthcare lies in a synthesis of compassionate human doctors and diagnostic AI."
15. transformative (adj)
/trænsˈfɔːmətɪv/
mang tính chuyển đổi sâu sắc, tạo ra bước ngoặt cách mạng
Collocation: transformative impact, transformative technology
"Artificial intelligence is proving to be the most transformative technology since the steam engine."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: IELTS Writing Task 1 (Mixed Charts) — Chiến Thuật Viết Kết Hợp 2 Biểu Đồ Khác Loại

• Đặc trưng của đề Mixed Charts (Biểu đồ Kết hợp: Line + Bar, hoặc Pie + Table): Bạn không bao giờ được gộp lẫn lộn số liệu 2 biểu đồ vào cùng một đoạn rối rắm. Hãy áp dụng Cấu trúc 4 Đoạn Chuẩn Giám Khảo (Band 8.0+):
  - Đoạn 1 (Introduction): Dùng liên từ while / whereas để giới thiệu cả 2 biểu đồ:
    The line graph illustrates [Biểu đồ 1], while the accompanying table/bar chart compares [Biểu đồ 2].
  - Đoạn 2 (Overview — 2 câu): Câu 1 nêu xu hướng chính của Biểu đồ 1; Câu 2 nêu đặc điểm cực đại của Biểu đồ 2 (hoặc mối tương quan correlation giữa 2 biểu đồ).
  - Đoạn 3 (Body 1): Phân tích chi tiết Biểu đồ 1 (mở đầu bằng Regarding the line graph, ...).
  - Đoạn 4 (Body 2): Chuyển đoạn mượt sang Biểu đồ 2 bằng Turning to the bar chart / table, ....

🔵 Tầng 2: Tổng Duyệt Ngữ Pháp 30 Units — Bẫy Hòa Hợp Chủ Ngữ - Động Từ & Hệ Thống Hóa C1-C2

• 4 Bẫy Hòa hợp Chủ ngữ - Động từ (Subject-Verb Agreement) hay gặp nhất trong phòng thi IELTS:
  1. The number of + N (số nhiều) + V (SỐ ÍT) vs. A number of + N (số nhiều) + V (SỐ NHIỀU):
    Ví dụ: The number of autonomous vehicles has surged, whereas a number of traditional jobs have become obsolete.
  2. S1 + along with / as well as / together with + S2 + V (chia theo S1):
    Ví dụ: The Prime Minister, along with twenty tech leaders, has signed the AI governance treaty.
  3. Danh từ không đếm được luôn chia số ít: information, disinformation, coverage, legislation, infrastructure, equipment, apparatus, research, welfare, debris.
  4. Danh từ tập hợp người/số nhiều: the elderly, the affluent, the impoverished, livestock, police, paparazzi luôn chia động từ số nhiều.

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. Self-driving cars and ________ delivery robots use sensors and AI to navigate city streets without human drivers.
2. Economists fear that factory automation could ________ millions of low-skilled assembly-line workers.
3. AI software is designed to ________ doctors' diagnostic abilities rather than replace human physicians.
4. Digital cameras and smartphones quickly rendered traditional film cameras ________ in the early 2000s.
5. Governments must fund adult education programmes to ________ middle-aged workers for the digital economy.
6. Automating repetitive paperwork allows employees to focus on creative tasks, boosting overall ________.
7. Privacy advocates warn that facial recognition ________ in public streets can infringe on civil liberties.
8. Comparing the line graph and the table reveals a clear positive ________ between education spending and GDP growth.
9. Demand for AI engineers skyrocketed by 75%; ________, employment in manual data entry dropped sharply.
10. The mixed charts show the ________ expansion of solar power and electric vehicle sales between 2015 and 2025.
11. Future classrooms will teach students how to ________ and collaborate ethically with artificial intelligence.
12. New legislation is needed to hold software corporations legally ________ when their AI algorithms cause harm.
13. World leaders met in Geneva to establish an international ________ framework for artificial intelligence safety.
14. The most effective medical care is a ________ of cutting-edge AI diagnostics and human compassion.
15. Generative AI is having a ________ impact on how software, medicine, and scientific research are conducted.
16. [Ôn tập Unit 29] Only by enforcing strict legal ________ can we prevent the abuse of human gene editing.
17. [Ôn tập Unit 28] Equitable access to quality public education is the main driver of upward social ________.
18. [Ôn tập Unit 27] Driven by lower labour costs, ________ corporations outsource manufacturing to developing nations.
19. [Ôn tập Unit 25] Volunteering to help strangers without any financial incentive demonstrates human ________.
20. [Ôn tập Unit 20] Agriculture dominated water usage in four nations, with the ________ exception of Germany.
Điểm: 0/20

⚙️ 10 Câu Test Ngữ Pháp Ứng Dụng (Grammar Mastery Test)

1. Subject-Verb Agreement Trap 1: The number of companies adopting AI ________ tripled over the past five years.
2. Subject-Verb Agreement Trap 2: A large number of routine clerical jobs ________ been rendered obsolete by automation.
3. Subject-Verb Agreement Trap 3: The Minister of Science, along with twenty AI researchers, ________ attending the governance summit today.
4. Task 1 Mixed Charts Transition: ________ to the accompanying bar chart, software engineering recorded the highest salary growth.
5. Inversion with 'Only by' (Review Unit 29): Only by reskilling the workforce ________ mass unemployment in the AI era.
6. Conditional Inversion (Review Unit 28): ________ tech corporations not held legally accountable, public trust in AI would collapse.
7. Fronted Participle Clause (Review Unit 27): ________ by significant productivity gains, banks have invested billions in autonomous algorithms.
8. Present Subjunctive (Review Unit 26): It is imperative that global AI governance ________ established before autonomous weapons proliferate.
9. Double Comparative (Review Unit 24): The more tasks artificial intelligence automates, ________ important human empathy and creativity become.
10. Concession (Review Unit 22): ________ the risk of short-term job displacement, AI will ultimately augment human prosperity.
Điểm: 0/10

💡 Bấm vào bất kỳ câu thoại nào để nghe riêng câu đó:
Programme Director: Good morning, National AI Reskilling and Future Workforce Institute, Director Dr. Marcus Sterling speaking. How may I assist you?
HR Manager: Hello Dr. Sterling! My name is Eleanor Vance-Houghton. I am the Human Resources Manager at a logistics firm, and I want to enroll our staff in your AI Reskilling Grant Programme.
Programme Director: We would be delighted to partner with your company, Eleanor! Could you spell the second part of your hyphenated surname after Vance?
HR Manager: Yes, it is Houghton. H - O - U - G - H - T - O - N. 💡 Đáp án câu 1 (Họ phần 2): HOUGHTON
Programme Director: Thank you. Why is your company seeking to reskill its workforce this quarter?
HR Manager: We are introducing autonomous warehouse robots next year, and rather than displacing our workers, we want to train them to manage the new technology. 💡 Đáp án câu 2 (Thiết bị tự hành trong kho): warehouse robots / robots
Programme Director: That is a model example of responsible corporate governance! How many employees will participate in the training?
HR Manager: We have 120 warehouse staff in total, and we are enrolling 85 employees in the first cohort. 💡 Bẫy tổng nhân sự (120) vs số người đăng ký đợt 1 câu 3: 85
Programme Director: Eighty-five is a great cohort size. Our twelve-week curriculum teaches staff how to use AI software to augment supply-chain productivity. 💡 Đáp án câu 4 (Thời lượng khóa học): 12 / twelve
HR Manager: Does the government provide a financial subsidy to cover the training tuition?
Programme Director: Yes! Under the National Workforce Transition Act, the government subsidizes 70% of the tuition cost for companies that guarantee zero redundancies. 💡 Đáp án câu 5 (Tỷ lệ % chính phủ tài trợ học phí): 70
HR Manager: Seventy percent funding is a huge incentive! What qualification do employees receive upon graduating?
Programme Director: Every graduate is awarded a certified Diploma in Digital Logistics. 💡 Đáp án câu 6 (Chứng chỉ nhận được): Digital Logistics
HR Manager: When does the next training cohort begin?
Programme Director: Classes begin on the 3rd of February, with both online modules and practical lab sessions. I will email your grant application pack right now!

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - Displacement versus Augmentation in the AI Era]
Artificial intelligence and robotics are exerting a transformative impact on the global economy. As autonomous algorithms master complex tasks ranging from legal research to medical diagnostics, many economists fear a wave of workforce displacement. Between 2015 and 2025, corporate investment in AI surged from $15 billion to $180 billion globally. While automation has rendered many routine clerical and assembly-line skills obsolete, labour statistics show that technology is also augmenting human capabilities and boosting overall productivity.

[Paragraph B - Mixed Data Analysis: Job Shifts Across Sectors (2015 - 2025)]
A closer examination of global employment data reveals a striking correlation between AI adoption and sectoral job changes. While the line graph of corporate AI spending rose twelvefold over the decade, the accompanying sectoral bar chart shows two converse employment trends occurring simultaneously. Specifically, routine administrative and traditional manufacturing roles shrank by 28% and 18% respectively. Conversely, employment in AI software engineering (+68%), renewable energy (+45%), and healthcare (+32%) expanded dramatically, proving that fields requiring technical creativity or human empathy cannot be easily automated.

[Paragraph C - Reskilling and Ethical AI Governance]
To ensure that humans and intelligent machines coexist harmoniously, proactive public policy is imperative. Rather than allowing displaced workers to fall into poverty, governments and corporations must invest heavily in lifelong vocational programmes to reskill the workforce. Furthermore, international authorities must establish a transparent governance framework that prevents intrusive biometric surveillance and holds tech corporations legally accountable for algorithmic bias. Ultimately, the most prosperous future lies in a synthesis of machine efficiency and human wisdom.
Điểm: 0/6
